properties.name: mlhub.feature-store.iceberg.hadoop-fs-s3a.aws-credentials-provider
properties.description:
Comma-separated class names of credential provider classes which implement software.amazon.awssdk.auth.credentials.AwsCredentialsProvider. 
When S3A delegation tokens are not enabled, this list will be used to directly authenticate with S3 and other AWS services. 
When S3A Delegation tokens are enabled, depending upon the delegation token binding it may be used to communicate wih the STS endpoint to request session/role credentials.
